description.value:
You release a burst of electricity in a 5-foot radius around yourself. Every other creature in range must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 lightning damage.

This power's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
